'''Lapad Dula''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During a mission on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Dula's men were been slowly and torturously digested in the belly of a [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]]. He asks a Republic spacer to end their suffering by dropping a poison grenade into the creature's maw.
